name: feature-stage quantile sketch
capability: Produces a 2.2 KB signed summary of stage-wise residual distributions in 38 ms.
limit: At most six sketches per hour within the 2 W envelope.

name: dormant adapter bank
capability: Stores 24 compressed 250 KB adapters and retrieves candidates by a 96-byte cue.
limit: Simultaneously active adapters are limited to three.

name: zone-time bulletin layer
capability: Writes signed 160-byte messages keyed by aisle, zone, and shift with configurable expiry.
limit: No raw features or images may enter a bulletin.

name: local disagreement parity
capability: Computes a 3 KB parity-style signature across eight protected diagnostic probes.
limit: Requires at least three non-identical model responses.

name: selective second-pass gate
capability: Runs a second adapter only on gated frames while keeping p95 below 80 ms at six percent activation.
limit: Higher activation violates the safety deadline.

name: peer capability registry
capability: Advertises compact signed competence ranges and adapter fingerprints without weights.
limit: Registry entries expire after 24 hours.

name: asynchronous peer relay
capability: Relays messages up to 4 KB among nearby robots without the central coordinator.
limit: Delivery is best effort and can be delayed by 12 minutes.

name: safe micro-perturbation harness
capability: Measures recovery from bounded synthetic feature perturbations during idle cycles.
limit: Cannot run during active safety alerts.
